data.name: Arkaan
data.gender_notes: Arkaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arkaan is a name of Arabic origin, derived from the Arabic word 'arkan' which means 'foundation' or 'base'. In Islamic context, Arkaan represents the one who lays the foundation of faith and righteousness. It is a name for a boy, symbolizing strength, protection, and a steadfast commitment to Islamic values. The name Arkaan carries the meaning “Guardian, Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arkaan usually hope their child will grow to embody guardian, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Servant of Allah, Guardian of Faith
data.etymology: Arkaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guardian, Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arkaan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
